articles.title: STI screening linked to fewer preterm births
articles.excerpt: Screening and treating pregnant patients for three common sexually transmitted infections (STIs) twice during pregnancy was associated with a 23% lower risk of preterm birth compared with standard care, according to a randomized clinical trial published in Clinical Infectious Diseases from researche
articles.summary: 一项随机临床试验发现，孕期对三种常见性传播感染进行两次筛查和治疗，与标准护理相比，与早产风险降低23%相关；结果发表于《Clinical Infectious Diseases》。
